tips.text: Join a clan that already has the Energy Lab researched instead of funding the research yourself.
Start a crafted Fieldron in the Energy Lab while you wait on invasions; the 12-hour timer runs for free.
Do Fieldron invasions first; crafting all ten one at a time means several days of timers.
Do not confuse Fieldron Sample with Fieldron; the recipe wants finished Fieldron.
People call the cost fair with no Forma; the only complaint is the 10 Fieldron.
